title: HIGenNTO: Scalable Humanoid Interaction Generation via Noise-Space Trajectory Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.22611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humanoid robots can acquire complex skills by imitating kinematic humanoid motion references, yet reliable references for contact-rich interactions remain difficult to obtain: motion capture deteriorates under occlusion and close physical contact, while retargeting introduces additional contact and geometric inconsistencies. We present HIGenNTO, a framework that synthesizes humanoid-scene interaction motion references by optimizing the initial noise of a pretrained text-conditioned motion model under sparse spatiotemporal and scene constraints. The same formulation satisfies desired contacts, avoids collisions, and maintains stable support while retaining the prior's realism and temporal coherence, generating interaction motions from scratch and composing long-horizon behaviors stage-wise. Across robot-environment and robot-object tasks, HIGenNTO produces motions that can be executed by tracking policies in simulation and used to train

translated_title: HIGenNTO：基于噪声空间轨迹优化的可扩展人形机器人交互生成
translated_abstract: 人形机器人可以通过模仿运动学的人形运动参考来获取复杂技能，然而针对富含接触的交互，可靠的参考仍然难以获得：动作捕捉在遮挡和近距离物理接触下会退化，而重定向会引入额外的接触和几何不一致性。我们提出HIGenNTO，这是一个通过在稀疏时空与场景约束下优化预训练文本条件运动模型的初始噪声，来合成人形-场景交互运动参考的框架。同一公式化方法能够满足期望的接触、避免碰撞并保持稳定的支撑，同时保留先验的真实性与时间连贯性，既能从零生成交互动作，也能分阶段组合长时程行为。在机器人-环境和机器人-物体任务中，HIGenNTO生成的动作可在仿真中被跟踪策略执行，并可用于训练（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出HIGenNTO框架，通过优化预训练文本条件运动模型的初始噪声，在稀疏时空与场景约束下合成满足接触、避碰和稳定支撑且可被执行策略跟踪的人形机器人场景交互运动参考。
en_tdlr: HIGenNTO synthesizes executable humanoid-scene interaction motion references by optimizing the initial noise of a pretrained text-conditioned motion model under sparse spatiotemporal and scene constraints, satisfying desired contacts, avoiding collisions, and maintaining stable support.
